headline: KSH International issues notice for shareholder postal ballot
hook: Postal ballot notice sent to shareholders
summary: KSH International Limited has submitted a notice regarding a postal ballot to the stock exchange. This routine corporate filing outlines items requiring shareholder approval through postal voting. Retail investors should note that corporate resolutions passed via postal ballot can impact company governance and strategic decisions. Reviewing the ballot details helps investors understand upcoming corporate actions.
why_it_matters: Upcoming corporate resolutions may affect company governance.

headline: 13 recent IPOs deliver returns up to 193%
hook: IPO winners from the past year
summary: Thirteen companies that launched IPOs since last Dhanteras have seen significant price appreciation. Omnitech Engineering leads the group with a 192.62% return from its issue price. Other notable performers include ESDS Software Solution and KSH International. These gains reflect a strong performance period for recent market entrants between October 2025 and November 2026.
why_it_matters: Recent IPOs show strong post-listing momentum for retail portfolios.

headline: KSH International informs exchange about capacity addition
hook: New production capacity added at KSH International
summary: KSH International Limited has formally notified the stock exchange regarding an addition to its operational capacity. Retail investors should note this is a procedural filing reflecting ongoing business operations without immediate earnings impact.
why_it_matters: Routine operational update with no immediate financial impact.

headline: KSH International releases Q2 and H1 FY2027 financial results
hook: Half-year figures out at KSH International
summary: KSH International Limited has submitted a press release to the stock exchange detailing its financial performance for the second quarter and first half of fiscal year 2027.
